unit: One substantive physical worksheet row; no merging or imputation; nominal five-second annotation grain, not guaranteed measured intervals.
eligibility: Nonblank transcript, RecallType 1 or 2, and one or two valid BroadSceneNum annotations in 1..44; both populated scene fields must validate.
noGold: Missing scene gold remains accounted for, including code 2; it is not a model error.
clock: Optional SecondsOfRecall; integer seconds or H:MM:SS. Missing/invalid time does not alter gold eligibility. No row-index time or fallback clock is invented.
estimand: Equal-participant mean of uniform eligible-row any-annotated-scene accuracy, separately for each condition. A predicted scene matches either annotated scene; complete recovery of multi-scene content is not measured.
undefinedParticipant: Retain in the population; report undefined full-population accuracy if any retained participant has zero eligible rows.
predictionAccounting: Every source unit requires exactly one outcome. Missing/duplicate/extra IDs refuse scoring; invalid labels, abstention and failure are wrong on eligible units. Scorer input is a sequence of [unit ID, outcome] pairs; mappings are refused because they erase duplicates.

split.algorithm: Within each condition, ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 fields memento-split/v1, decimal seed, condition, participant, separated by LF (U+000A, byte 0A), with no trailing separator; first n test, remainder development; output IDs sorted by numeric suffix.
